title.en: Fable 5 — The Fox and the Stork

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: A fox and a stork were good friends.

sentences.ar: יום אחד השועל אמר לה: בואי לאכול.
sentences.en: One day the fox said to her: come to eat.
The stork was very happy and came in the evening.
The fox put soup in a flat plate.
The fox ate everything very fast.

sentences.ar: החסידה ניסתה, אבל היא לא הצליחה.
sentences.en: The stork tried, but she did not succeed.
Her neck was long and narrow.
The fox laughed after she went out.

sentences.ar: אחרי שבוע החסידה אמרה: בוא אליי.
sentences.en: After a week the stork said: come to me.
The fox came, and he was hungry.

sentences.ar: היא שמה את האוכל בכד גבוה וצר.
sentences.en: She put the food in a tall, narrow jar.

sentences.ar: היא הכניסה את הראש ואכלה יפה.
sentences.en: She put in her head and ate nicely.

sentences.ar: השועל הסתכל על הכד ולא הצליח.
sentences.en: The fox looked at the jar and did not succeed.

sentences.ar: האף שלו היה גדול מדי בשבילו.
sentences.en: His nose was too big for it.

sentences.ar: הוא הלך הביתה בלי לאכול כלום.
sentences.en: He went home without eating anything.
What you do comes back to you.
